comparison: Complete recipe versus accepted G2B ResNet18 and F5, not isolated architecture/pretraining/pixel exposure. Two outer folds, one seed; no holdout/test. At least +.005 PQ, both folds positive, two-comparison-adjusted group-bootstrap lower bound positive; recall losses <=.05 small, .03 large, .03 limb against both references.

decoder.component: max pixels inside predicted box, then area, then scan order
decoder.ownership: descending confidence with candidate order tie; remove accepted pixels then keep largest connected fragment
decoder.score: detector probability times mean selected-component mask probability
decoder.selection: final inner maximum official PQ, ties smaller area, mask nearest .5, confidence nearest .3, lower confidence; freeze both before any outer

detector.batch_norm: all running statistics frozen; affine parameters trained

optimizer.determinism: Fixed seeds; detector training CUDA ROIAlign backward may be nondeterministic. Exact separate-process inference required; no bit-exact training claim.
optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: warmup then cosine to 1% at fixed final update

proposal.gate: both final inner folds before refiner quality training; if failed, one separately justified frozen remedy at most; no automatic tuning

quality_gate: Engineering proof and resource estimates must pass, and final config/source hashes must freeze before quality fits.

refiner.labels: one supplied selected instance; other instances excluded; negatives empty only relative to chosen supplied annotator
refiner.normalization: both channels (x-.5)/.25; extra hint kernels initialized zero

resources.engineering_note: Two70-update fixtures plus inference-only checks; unscored training-only engineering, discarded models.

retention: Keep all new checkpoints and final weights; stream artifacts directly to Windows without duplicate Linux archives. No deletion of accepted artifacts. No G5 or competition submission.
